identification: Five Tasmanian books: Domain House (Freeman, modern), Site (TMAG, modern), Macquarie Island (J.S. Cumpston, Antarctic Division, 1968, first ed, jacket), The Story of Wybalenna (P. F. Ratcliff, ill. Eric Ratcliff, c.1975, jacket), Collection (TMAG, modern). Only Cumpston and perhaps Wybalenna have any value; the other three are modern institutional titles worth little.
